files.index.html:
FICTIONAL DELIVERY · VERSION 2

Room for every guest.
Proof for every booking.

Each booking accepts at most 6 people.

Each time slot accepts at most 8 guests in total.

This static page displays the agreement. The separately declared disposable reference service is checked through ProofBeforePay's seventeen-step HTTP protocol. This page does not itself send bookings.

Controlled developer fixture · no customer data, emails or real payment

source.excerpt: Each booking accepts at most 6 people.
Each booking accepts at most 6 people
Each time slot accepts at most 8 guests in total.

steps.label: Declared capacity target revision
steps.expected: HTTP200 and exact declared protocol/revision/registration association

steps.label: Slot A starts empty
steps.expected: HTTP200; this run/slot/revision, guestCount0 and no booking IDs

steps.label: Reject a party above the agreed per-booking limit
steps.expected: HTTP400/422 code party_size_exceeded for 7 guests

steps.label: First distinct-key capacity contender
steps.expected: Together: one201 exact 5-guest receipt and one409 slot_capacity_exceeded

steps.label: Second distinct-key capacity contender
steps.expected: Together: one201 exact 5-guest receipt and one409 slot_capacity_exceeded
steps.actual: HTTP 409; exactlyOneCreatedAndOneCapacityRejection: true; structured capacity rejection matched

steps.label: Final readback of the retained winning receipt
steps.expected: HTTP200; original winning ID and 5-guest fields after every later write

steps.label: Read occupancy after the capacity race
steps.expected: HTTP200; guestCount5 and exactly the winning booking ID

steps.label: Replay the actual winning key
steps.expected: HTTP200; exact original winning ID/fields, no additional capacity consumed

steps.label: Read occupancy after winner replay
steps.expected: HTTP200; guestCount5 and only the same winning booking ID

steps.label: Fill the remaining agreed slot capacity
steps.expected: HTTP201; new 3-guest receipt distinct from the race winner

steps.label: Final readback of the retained fill receipt
steps.expected: HTTP200; original fill ID and 3-guest fields after every later write

steps.label: Read the exactly full slot
steps.expected: HTTP200; guestCount8 and exactly the winner/fill booking IDs

steps.label: Reject one guest above full slot capacity
steps.expected: HTTP409 code slot_capacity_exceeded; no additional booking

steps.label: Final slot A occupancy after rejection and slot B writes
steps.expected: HTTP200; guestCount8 and original two IDs, unchanged by other-slot creation

steps.label: Create a maximum-size booking in independent slot B
steps.expected: HTTP201; distinct receipt for 6 guests in slot B

steps.label: Read back the independent slot B booking
steps.expected: HTTP200; exact slot B receipt and 6-guest fields

steps.label: Read independent slot B occupancy
steps.expected: HTTP200; guestCount6 and only slot B's booking ID
